data.description: Acquisition storage and analysis-input policy. Controls canonical waveform formats and optional screenshot capture.

input.description: Waveform source used by analysis. Auto selects available canonical data, preferring verified raw data.

generator.description: Optional function-generator configuration. Required only by commands that trigger or automate a measurement.

connection.title: Function-generator transport URI

model.description: Function-generator driver model. Required when the generator table is present.
model.title: Function-generator driver model

generator.title: Optional function-generator configuration

lockin.description: Numerical lock-in settings. Defines signal channels, parallelism, output stride, and low-pass filtering.

channels.description: Channels demodulated by lock-in analysis. At least one channel is required by lock-in and downstream analysis.
channels.title: Channels demodulated by lock-in analysis
x-constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

debug_label.description: Safe suffix for debug artifacts. The label is restricted to a short ASCII filename-safe subset.
debug_label.title: Safe suffix for debug artifacts

debug_output.description: Lock-in debug artifact output. Enable only for filter inspection because artifacts can be large.

debug_overwrite.title: Debug artifact overwrite policy

estimator.description: Lock-in estimator selection (schema v7). boxcar_legacy keeps the historical estimator; joint_harmonic_gls is an explicit opt-in with its own settings. Estimator selection is never a filter kind.

kind.description: Lock-in estimator algorithm. boxcar_legacy is the historical estimator. joint_harmonic_gls selects the phase-aware joint harmonic estimator and requires its settings block.
kind.title: Lock-in estimator algorithm

calibration_source.description: Calibration source for the joint estimator. artifact keeps the file-bound behavior: one immutable calibration artifact per lock-in channel. prepulse derives each channel noise model once per LI run from pulse.background_before and records prepulse_calibration_digest in the LI provenance; calibrations must be empty alongside prepulse.
calibration_source.title: Calibration source for the joint estimator

calibrations.description: Immutable calibration bindings, one per lock-in channel. Each entry binds a channel to a calibration artifact path plus its expected SHA-256 digest. Unexpanded template placeholders are rejected. Required exactly once per channel in artifact mode; must be empty when calibration_source is prepulse.
calibrations.title: Immutable calibration bindings, one per lock-in channel

covariance_output.description: XY covariance serialization mode. Controls how much of the estimator covariance is written to run artifacts.
covariance_output.title: XY covariance serialization mode

envelope_degree.description: Envelope polynomial degree. Exactly 0 in v1: no envelope drift terms are supported.
envelope_degree.title: Envelope polynomial degree

failure_policy.description: Estimator failure policy. Exactly error in v1: any estimator failure aborts the run instead of falling back.
failure_policy.title: Estimator failure policy

fit_harmonics.description: Harmonics spanned by the joint fit. Ascending unique positive harmonics. Must contain every output harmonic; the model size 1 + 2 * len must stay within the parameter limit.
fit_harmonics.title: Harmonics spanned by the joint fit
x-constraints: must be ascending unique positive harmonics

kind.description: Lock-in estimator algorithm. boxcar_legacy is the historical estimator. joint_harmonic_gls selects the phase-aware joint harmonic estimator and requires its settings block.
kind.title: Lock-in estimator algorithm

noise_mode.description: GLS noise model family. Selects the whitening contract: identity, per-phase diagonal, stationary correlated, or phase-correlated.
noise_mode.title: GLS noise model family

output_harmonics.description: Harmonics reported by the joint estimator. Exactly 1 through 6 in v1.
output_harmonics.title: Harmonics reported by the joint estimator

estimator.title: Lock-in estimator selection (schema v7)
x-constraints: GLS-only settings are rejected under boxcar_legacy

filter.description: Lock-in low-pass filter configuration. Schema v6 and earlier: the runtime accepts the boxcar_legacy kind; fields from other kinds are rejected. Schema v7 replaces this table with lockin.window and lockin.estimator.

save_npy.description: NumPy output for lock-in results. Writes NPY artifacts in addition to canonical CSV results.
save_npy.title: NumPy output for lock-in results

snr_background_window.description: Optional background window for SNR diagnostics. An inline table with finite start and end values.

stride_samples.description: Lock-in output stride in input samples. Input sample rate divided by this value gives the output sample rate.

fields.details_ja: 従来boxcarの端部トリム動作を維持する。

constraints: GLS-only settings are rejected under boxcar_legacy
fields.details_en: boxcar_legacy keeps the historical estimator; joint_harmonic_gls is an explicit opt-in with its own settings. Estimator selection is never a filter kind.
fields.details_ja: boxcar_legacyは従来推定器。joint_harmonic_glsは独自設定つき明示opt-in。推定器選択はfilter kindではない。

fields.details_en: boxcar_legacy is the historical estimator. joint_harmonic_gls selects the phase-aware joint harmonic estimator and requires its settings block.
fields.details_ja: boxcar_legacyは従来推定器。joint_harmonic_glsは位相考慮joint harmonic推定器で設定ブロック必須。
fields.summary_ja: lock-in 推定器アルゴリズム

constraints: must be ascending unique positive harmonics
fields.details_en: Ascending unique positive harmonics. Must contain every output harmonic; the model size 1 + 2 * len must stay within the parameter limit.
fields.details_ja: 昇順・重複なし・正の高調波。出力高調波をすべて含む。モデル規模1 + 2 * lenはパラメータ上限内。
fields.summary_en: Harmonics spanned by the joint fit.

fields.details_en: Exactly 1 through 6 in v1.
fields.details_ja: v1では1から6まで過不足なく。
fields.summary_en: Harmonics reported by the joint estimator.

fields.details_en: Exactly 0 in v1: no envelope drift terms are supported.
fields.details_ja: v1では0のみ。包絡ドリフト項は未対応。

fields.details_en: Selects the whitening contract: identity, per-phase diagonal, stationary correlated, or phase-correlated.
fields.details_ja: 白色化契約の選択。identity・位相別対角・定常相関・位相相関。

fields.details_en: Controls how much of the estimator covariance is written to run artifacts.
fields.details_ja: 推定器共分散のrun成果物への書き出し量を制御。

fields.details_en: Exactly error in v1: any estimator failure aborts the run instead of falling back.
fields.details_ja: v1ではerrorのみ。失敗時は代替動作せずrun中断。

fields.details_en: artifact keeps the file-bound behavior: one immutable calibration artifact per lock-in channel. prepulse derives each channel noise model once per LI run from pulse.background_before and records prepulse_calibration_digest in the LI provenance; calibrations must be empty alongside prepulse.
fields.details_ja: artifactはファイル束縛の現行動作。prepulseはpulse.background_beforeからLI実行毎にchannel毎の雑音モデルを一度だけ導出し、LI provenanceにprepulse_calibration_digestを記録。prepulse選択時はcalibrationsは空でなければならない。
fields.summary_en: Calibration source for the joint estimator.

constraints: exactly one entry per lockin.channels value (artifact mode)
fields.details_en: Each entry binds a channel to a calibration artifact path plus its expected SHA-256 digest. Unexpanded template placeholders are rejected. Required exactly once per channel in artifact mode; must be empty when calibration_source is prepulse.
fields.details_ja: channelとcalibration成果物パス＋期待SHA-256の束縛。未展開テンプレートは拒否。artifact方式ではchannel毎に1件必須。calibration_sourceがprepulseの場合は空でなければならない。
fields.summary_en: Immutable calibration bindings, one per lock-in channel.

fields.details_en: Optional TOL-06/07 policy carriers for the joint estimator and the pre-pulse nuisance fit. Every key is optional; an absent table or absent key keeps the frozen default, so existing v7 configs behave byte-identically.
fields.details_ja: joint推定器とpre-pulse nuisance fit用のTOL-06/07ポリシー。すべて任意。テーブル欠落・キー欠落は凍結済み既定値を保持し、既存v7設定の動作はバイト同一。

fields.details_en: Must be finite and positive. Smaller values keep weaker singular directions; larger values reject them earlier.
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ正。既定1e-10。小さいほど弱い特異方向を残し、大きいほど早期に棄却。
fields.summary_en: Relative singular-value floor for rank decisions.
fields.summary_ja: ランク判定の相対特異値フロア

fields.details_en: Must be finite and positive. Windows whose scaled-design condition exceeds it fail instead of publishing.
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ正。既定1e8。超過ウィンドウは公開せず失敗扱い。
fields.summary_ja: スケール済みdesignの条件数棄却閾値

fields.details_en: Must be finite and positive. Caps the executed covariance conditioning (TOL-07).
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ正。既定1e10。実行時共分散の条件付けを制限（TOL-07）。
fields.summary_ja: 実現雑音共分散の条件数上限

fields.details_en: Must be finite and non-negative. Zero (default) disables jitter: a non-SPD Toeplitz factor fails instead of regularizing silently.
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ非負。既定0.0（無効）。非SPD Toeplitz因子は暗黙正則化せず失敗扱い。

fields.details_en: Optional FR-06 split-half policy for pre-pulse derivation. Every key is optional; an absent table or absent key keeps the frozen default. The gate stays mandatory for every noise mode.
fields.details_ja: pre-pulse導出用FR-06 split-halfポリシー。すべて任意で既定は凍結値。ゲート自体は全noise_modeで必須のまま。

fields.details_en: Must be positive. Lags compared across phase octants in the split-half check.
fields.details_ja: 正の整数。既定4。split-half検査で位相octant間にわたり比較するlag数。

fields.details_en: Must be positive. Cells below this coverage carry no adequacy evidence.
fields.details_ja: 正の整数。既定10。これ未満のセルはadequacy証拠なし扱い。
fields.summary_en: Minimum lag pairs per phase cell.
fields.summary_ja: 位相セル毎の最小lagペア数

fields.details_en: Must be finite and non-negative. Training/half splits disagreeing beyond it refuse derivation. Relaxing the bar needs approval; on failure retake the interval or data.
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ非負。既定0.2。これを超える不一致は導出拒否。緩和は承認事項。失敗時は区間・データを再取得。

fields.details_en: Must be finite and non-negative. Pooled training-vs-reserved shifts beyond it refuse derivation.
fields.details_ja: 有限かつ非負。既定0.2。これを超えるshiftは導出拒否。

constraints: fields from other filter kinds are rejected
fields.details_en: Schema v6 and earlier: the runtime accepts the boxcar_legacy kind; fields from other kinds are rejected. Schema v7 replaces this table with lockin.window and lockin.estimator.
fields.details_ja: schema v6以前はboxcar_legacyのみ。v7ではlockin.window/lockin.estimatorに置換。
